decisions.reason: The preferred reference concerns character features and detail; it does not change the requirement for visual continuity among set images.
Selecting a character feature-detail reference does not change the existing rule to maintain artistic style consistency and prevent drift.
The source selects a reference for character features and detail, not a quality standard or generation policy for set images.
The character reference preference does not alter the animation acceptance condition.
The preferred character feature-detail reference does not change the requirement to restore character shadows while preserving other image elements.
Character appearance reference selection does not change the CC1 shot framing progression, image-pair structure, or unresolved distant-framing question.
The source does not alter which bridges must be retained or removed in the affected Q images.
The character reference preference does not change the fallback format, activation condition, or delivery precedence.
The source does not change the inclusion or deferred status of the opening aerial establishing shot.
Selecting a character feature-detail reference does not alter script-versus-storyboard precedence or desired shot-angle accuracy.
